narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, self-deprecating comedy skit to promote the dating app 'Omi'. The creator argues that while 'scumbags' (渣男) get all the attention, honest and simple men like himself are often ignored. By proving his 'purity' (no one messages him but his mother), he positions himself as a high-quality 'brand new' partner, ultimately encouraging viewers to find similarly good men on the Omi app.
